_note: WP7 look gates (ci/look_metrics.py) and 2-up sheets (ci/twoup.py). Each scene: the shots tried in order (the first that exists is measured; a HUD-off one, `*-nohud-*`, is gated, a HUD-on one is measured inside the HUD mask and only reported), the gates, the golden today frame (native-metal 385e8a7, the tree before WP7, HUD on) and the concept panel. Ranges follow the user's blend (base «Кристалл» + horror's beams and deep darkness + frost's rime): frame median 35–50 (between crisp's 50–60 and horror's floor; the plan's frost-base swarmshot range 40–55 is printed next to it), the swarmshot gates of the plan (p95/p50 ≥ 3.6, specks ≥ 800, clipped ≤ 0.8 %, R−B highlights ≥ +25, shadows ≤ −10), near-black ≤ 30 % (horror's limit). native-vx-feel re-baseline (package F, the approved feel build: the swarm at the wave pacing's live caps, bigger and varied bugs, fewer and calmer effects): the reference frames today-<scene>.jpg are that build's own HUD-off shots (CI native-vx-feel c500515, the extraction's from its re-shoot) instead of the Russian HUD-on frames of native-metal 385e8a7; each scene carries `feel_baseline`, the numbers of that run; a gate moved only where the look changed on purpose (swarmshot._feel_note).

swarmshot._feel_note: native-vx-feel: p95/p50 3.6 -> 3.2. The store moment now spawns the game's own crowd (the store's 600 under High's live cap of 350: ~200 bodies on screen instead of ~360), so the bright pores that made its highlights are fewer while the median stays (39.1 on 15657ee, 5c8ad76 and c6029ec): p95 168 -> 134, p95/p50 4.32 -> 3.43 (c6029ec; 3.46 on c500515, 3.71 on 01c636a; 3.74–4.38 over the 600-bug runs). 3.2 sits ~0.2 under the measured value for the run-to-run spread; the other swarmshot gates (median, specks ≥ 800 — 1104 —, clip, warm, cold, dark) are unchanged and pass.

beacon._warm_note: R−B of the beacon's highlights is reported, not gated: it follows the effect on screen at the shot (+40 with fire, +9 with the cryo beam on two runs of the same tree)

punchin._review_note: feel-build review: near-black ceiling 35 -> 40. Since the feel build the crowd in the punch-in is the game's own chunky, dark-chitin bugs (package F's look variety, B1's bodies) rather than the small pink ones, and the held moment decides how many sit right under the lens: on identical code the HUD-off shot measured 24.3-35.5 % (native-metal 9c93169 35.0, e765953 37.7 after a 35.8 first shot, 8f1e677 33.8, 73ec579 35.5 after 37.4; branch runs 25.0-34.9). Both of 73ec579's frames over 35 checked by eye at phone size: a deck full of black bodies under the lit mast, no veil, no crushed blacks. The floor (12 %, the grey-veil regression) and p95/p50 >= 3.6 are unchanged.
punchin._median_note: a close-up: its median follows the framing (the lit deck around the squad fills the frame), so it is reported, not gated; the shot EV keeps the deck from going milky. native-vx-fix: contrast gated (p95/p50 ≥ 3.6, near-black ≥ 12 %) — native-metal 2d38dfd passed at median 66.7, p95/p50 3.31, dark 9.6 % under a grey veil (the effects' lights of a weapon firing near the lens; LightGrid.punchInFxLightCut)
punchin._feel_note: native-vx-feel: gates unchanged. c6029ec's HUD-off punch-in failed on a grey veil over the middle of the frame (near-black 3.5 %, p95/p50 3.32 — the same flake as native-vx-marine-look 893760b, p95/p50 3.49, before package F): the pyro's flamer smoke hanging lit in its own flashlight cone at the held, frozen moment; the flamer smoke is thinner since (6 puffs/s at alpha 0.5, was 10 at 0.7). c500515 (thinner smoke): median 37.6, p95/p50 5.31, near-black 28.6 %; its HUD-off shot is the reference frame. A HUD-off shot that fails a gate is shot once more in sim-smoke (gate-reruns.txt) before this job gates it.

extract._review_note: feel-build review: near-black ceiling 35 -> 42. The extraction frame is darker by design since M1 / M2 (matte field-grey armour, only visors and lamps glow) and F / B1 (dark-chitin bugs on the deck): on identical code the HUD-off shot measured 24.9-41.1 % across 19 runs (first shots over 35 on 79eef3f, 9c93169, e765953, 45cc4c2, 8f1e677, 067cd21, eaf5b4d; native-metal e765953 / 8f1e677 red on it after the re-shoot). The 36.5-40.1 % frames of native-metal 8f1e677 / e765953 and eaf5b4d were checked at phone size: the squad lit side-on against the dark shaft, a brute on the deck in silhouette, nothing crushed. The median band (the hazy, looking-down failure) and the clip ceiling are unchanged.
